question: For each tenant that (1) has at least one port bound to a security group with admin_state_up = 1 and (2) has at least one port that is DOWN with port security enabled, list the tenant ID, the total number of DOWN ports with port security enabled and the average of that count across tenants, the total number of admin-up ports with security-group bindings along with total security-group bindings and DNS records and the average of that port count across tenants, and the ratio (rounded to 2 decimals) of DOWN+secure ports to admin-up security-group-bound ports.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_secure AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_secure_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
),
admin_up_sg AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS admin_up_sg_port_count,
         COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS total_sg_bindings
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
),
dns_counts AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(pd.port_id) AS dns_record_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portdnses pd ON p.id = pd.port_id
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.tenant_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
)
SELECT
  q.tenant_id,
  d.down_secure_count,
  AVG(d.down_secure_count) OVER () AS avg_down_secure_count,
  a.admin_up_sg_port_count,
  a.total_sg_bindings,
  COALESCE(dc.dns_record_count, 0) AS dns_record_count,
  AVG(a.admin_up_sg_port_count) OVER () AS avg_admin_up_sg_port_count,
  ROUND(d.down_secure_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(a.admin_up_sg_port_count, 0), 2) AS ratio
FROM qualifying q
JOIN down_secure d ON q.tenant_id = d.tenant_id
JOIN admin_up_sg a ON q.tenant_id = a.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN dns_counts dc ON q.tenant_id = dc.tenant_id

    p.tenant_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_secure,

  LEFT JOIN portdnses pd ON pd.port_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1

    JOIN securitygroups sg2 ON sg2.id = sgpb2.security_group_id

  )
  AND b.down_secure > 0
)

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    p.tenant_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_secure,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.admin_state_up = 1 AND sgpb.security_group_id IS NOT NULL THEN p.id END) AS admin_up_sg_ports,
    COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS sg_bindings,
    COUNT(pd.port_id) AS dns_records
  FROM ports p
  LEFT JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN portdnses pd ON pd.port_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.tenant_id
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM ports p2
    JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb2 ON sgpb2.port_id = p2.id
    JOIN securitygroups sg2 ON sg2.id = sgpb2.security_group_id
    WHERE p2.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND sg2.admin_state_up = 1
  )
  AND b.down_secure > 0
)
SELECT
  f.tenant_id,
  f.down_secure,
  AVG(f.down_secure) OVER () AS avg_down_secure,
  f.admin_up_sg_ports,
  f.sg_bindings,
  f.dns_records,
  AVG(f.admin_up_sg_ports) OVER () AS avg_admin_up_sg_ports,
  ROUND(f.down_secure / f.admin_up_sg_ports, 2) AS ratio
FROM filtered f;
